summary: Validated the new payment system (Phases A/B/C) and re-ran the full regression suite. NEW /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py = 21/21 PASS. Existing /app/backend/tests/test_islandhop_backend.py = 27/27 PASS. APScheduler 'nightly_vendor_payouts' is confirmed registered at startup. Backend total: 48/48 (100%).

minor.issue: Duplicate `class OrderItem(BaseModel)` definitions remain (server.py line 134 AND line 619). Main agent removed the duplicate `class Order` but the `OrderItem` shadow is still present. The second definition wins at import time and currently happens to be compatible, but this is a latent bug — drift between the two will cause confusing 422s.

Calling with an unknown/invalid session_id surfaces a Stripe 4xx via the SDK as a 500 (not a clean 404). Recommend wrapping `stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status` in try/except → 404 if Stripe says 'No such checkout session' and 502 on other Stripe errors. Currently the test allows 400/404/500; behaviour observed in this run was 500.

action_items: (LOW) Remove duplicate `class OrderItem(BaseModel)` at server.py:619 — keep only the line-134 definition. The redefinition is dead code and a footgun for future edits.
(LOW) In get_checkout_status (server.py:3573), wrap `await stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(...)` in try/except so an unknown session_id returns 404 instead of bubbling a 500.

(INFO) On test_400_when_already_paid the test seeds `payment_status='paid'` directly in Mongo to avoid a real Stripe checkout flow. This is acceptable for test-mode but documents that we cannot E2E a real card capture in this environment.
critical_code_review_comments: Phase A checkout/session correctly reads amount from DB (line 3534) — amount is NOT trusted from request body. Good.
Phase A status endpoint is idempotent: it checks `already_paid` BEFORE updating, and the order update uses `payment_status: {$ne: 'paid'}` as a guard. Good — re-polling will not double-mark.

Phase A canonical and legacy webhook handlers both return 400 on missing/invalid signature (verified). However the in-band webhook (called by stripe directly) does NOT cross-check the session metadata.order_id matches the DB txn metadata — if a session_id were ever reused across orders, the wrong order could be marked paid. Defence-in-depth only.
Phase B onboarding: if a vendor user with no profile calls /vendor/connect/onboarding, server returns 404 BEFORE calling Stripe — Stripe.Account.create is NOT invoked unnecessarily. Good.
Phase C refund: 403 path (non-owner non-admin) exists but is NOT tested here because we have no easy 'other user owns a paid order' setup. Documented for future testing agent.

Phase C driver payout: ordering of checks is wallet-balance THEN connect-status. If a driver has $0 balance AND no Stripe Connect, the 400 message will be 'Minimum payout amount is $10' which is slightly misleading. Cosmetic.

APScheduler is started inside FastAPI's @app.on_event('startup') — under uvicorn --workers > 1 the job would register N times. With supervisor running a single worker this is fine; document this constraint if scaling out.
Duplicate `class OrderItem` at server.py:134 and 619 (re-flagged above). server.py is now 4505 lines — still recommended to split into routers (auth, orders, payments, vendor, driver, analytics).
test_credentials: Tests register fresh users per run with unique emails like sched_test_<timestamp>_<uuid>@test.com / Test1234!. JWT Bearer auth only.
seed_data_creation: Each run: 3 throwaway users (customer/restaurant/driver); a few scheduled/recurring orders; 1 address; 1 promo code; 1 support ticket; ~5 food orders for checkout tests; 1 paid-status mark in mongo for the 'already paid' test; 1 drivers row for the payout test. No persistent fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest suites cover backend: /app/backend/tests/test_islandhop_backend.py (27 cases — health/auth/scheduled/recurring/addresses/promo/support/admin/analytics/driver/vendor/ratings/menu) and /app/backend/tests/test_payments.py (21 cases — POST /orders commission split, Phase A checkout session+status+webhook canonical and legacy, Phase B vendor connect status+onboarding, Phase C refunds + driver payouts). Both fully use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and shared conftest fixtures. Total = 48 tests passing 100%. APScheduler is verified started at boot ('nightly_vendor_payouts'). Two minor cosmetic improvements suggested in action_items (duplicate OrderItem class and 500-vs-404 on bad session_id) — neither blocks the payment functionality.
rca of the issue: No active issues. Iteration_2 had reported 2 pre-existing failures (PUT /addresses overwrite + promo-codes datetime); both are now passing — main agent appears to have patched them between iteration_2 and this run, since /api/promo-codes/{code}/validate now returns 200 and the addresses test_crud (including set-default) passes.
